reviews.text:
I like it, but it could use more features. I like how this app tracks things. It makes keeping up with moods and habits incredibly flexible. All it really needs is notes, export options and more organization features. Stats and numbers only tell a small part of the story. 
Grouping habits, routines, moods, timers, etc. would be helpful in navigating a long list of things to track.
 Adding notes or images when checking off an item as something of a micro journal would help in reflecting on moods and habits, making it helpful for managing mental health (depression, adhd, etc). The habit and mood trackers I currently use allow csv and pdf exporting options, which makes it easy to add to Day One or share with my therapist. 
Also, this isn’t a vital or essential request, but a true dark/black/oled theme, possibly with custom colors, would make the themes of this app more personal and enjoyable to use. 
Like I said, the strength of this app is in its flexibility, but it’s missing some important features that would get me to switch to this app.
